# Floating constants in a scoped constructor delegation

An owned generic child forwards a covariant map and decoded float/double
constants through original this calls beside int/long overloads. Four frozen
routes compare 96 cases twice for source and SDK parents, observing exact
floating bits (including negative zero), original input/receiver identities,
parent/target/wrapper order, callback mutations, partial state, exact failures
and later key casts. Every recovered unit and original metadata entry,
including a methodless marker, is compiled and audited. Wrong programs and
Code-preserving Signature controls guard the observer and source scopes.
Only owned classes execute.
